description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Fiend Hunter.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
